title: "extract_PCGR_annotations_29_genes"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-21"

# ============================================================
# Extract PCGR annotations for 29 multi-tool consensus genes
#
# Input:
#   One *.pcgr.grch38.xlsx file per sample folder
#   Sheet: SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL
#
# Primary extracted fields:
#   LOSS_OF_FUNCTION
#   VAF_TUMOR
#   ONCOGENICITY
#
# Output:
#   PCGR rows matched to Tier 1 common MAF variants only.
#   Separate MAF audit preserves unmatched variants as annotation unknown.
# ============================================================
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
  library(maftools)
})

# ============================================================
# 1. Paths
# ============================================================

PCGR_DIR <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/",
  "With_PON/pcgr_outputs"
)

OUTPUT_DIR <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/",
  "Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/Driver_Gene_Analysis/",
  "MultiTool_Consensus_29_Genes"
)

OUTPUT_FILE <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  paste0("MultiTool_Consensus_29_Genes_Tier1_common_PCGR_",
         format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"), ".tsv")
)

dir.create(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Consensus genes
# ============================================================

CONSENSUS_GENES <- c(
  # Supported by four tools
  "AGAP2",
  "CD2BP2",
  "DLK2",
  "HSD17B14",
  "MTMR2",
  "NINJ2",
  "PLXNA1",
  "POLD1",

  # Supported by three tools
  "CACNA1B",
  "CDH1",
  "DLG1",
  "EPHA8",
  "FHIP1B",
  "GALNT14",
  "GLT1D1",
  "GPR179",
  "GPX4",
  "IGFBP6",
  "JPH1",
  "PHLDB3",
  "PIK3CA",
  "RBFOX1",
  "SYTL3",
  "TDG",
  "TSPAN18",
  "TTN",
  "TYW1",
  "ZMYM3",
  "ZNF536"
)

if (length(unique(CONSENSUS_GENES)) != 29) {
  stop("The consensus gene list does not contain exactly 29 unique genes.")
}

# Restrict to the SAME MAF and maftools data slot as the slide 25 oncoplot.
set.seed(42)
MAF_FILE <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/",
  "Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/",
  "Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"
)
maf_obj <- read.maf(maf = MAF_FILE, useAll = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
maf_all <- as.data.table(maf_obj@data)
cohort_n <- uniqueN(maf_all$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
maf_dt <- copy(maf_all[Hugo_Symbol %in% CONSENSUS_GENES])
required <- c("Chromosome", "Start_Position", "Reference_Allele",
              "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Hugo_Symbol")
if (!all(required %in% names(maf_dt))) stop("Required genomic MAF columns missing.")
clean_sample <- function(x) sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(x))))
maf_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
if (any(maf_dt[, .(n_ids = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)), by = Sample_key]$n_ids > 1L)) {
  stop("Sample normalization collapses distinct MAF sample IDs; review naming.")
}

# Canonical edit representation: trim identical allele suffix/prefix bases.
# This reconciles VCF anchor bases with standard unanchored MAF indels.
# It does NOT left-align repeats: unresolved matches remain unknown in the audit.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))
  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) || !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L) return(NA_character_)
  if (!grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) || !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) return(NA_character_)
  if (maf && ref == "-") pos <- pos + 1L # MAF insertion start is left flanking base.
  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) == substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref)-1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt)-1L)
  }
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) && substr(ref,1,1) == substr(alt,1,1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref,2); alt <- substring(alt,2); pos <- pos+1L
  }
  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(chr, pos, ifelse(nzchar(ref),ref,"-"), ifelse(nzchar(alt),alt,"-"), sep=":")
}
maf_dt[, Variant_key := mapply(edit_key, Chromosome, Start_Position,
                               Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
                               MoreArgs=list(maf=TRUE), USE.NAMES=FALSE)]
if (anyNA(maf_dt$Variant_key)) stop("MAF variants could not be normalized; inspect input.")
maf_dt[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Hugo_Symbol, Variant_key, sep="|")]

# Accept explicit CHROM/POS/REF/ALT or common genomic-change encodings.
# Unsupported encodings fail closed and are written to the excluded-row audit.
pcgr_key <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  x <- gsub("_", ":", x, fixed=TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", ":", x, fixed=TRUE)
  a <- strsplit(x, ":", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(a) != 4L) return(NA_character_)
  edit_key(a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4])
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Find PCGR Excel files
# ============================================================

pcgr_files <- list.files(
  PCGR_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(pcgr_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No *.pcgr.grch38.xlsx files were found under:\n",
    PCGR_DIR
  )
}

cat("PCGR files found:", length(pcgr_files), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 4. Columns to retain
# ============================================================

# LOSS_OF_FUNCTION, VAF_TUMOR and ONCOGENICITY are the primary
# requested columns. Additional fields are retained to support
# biological interpretation of each variant.

KEEP_COLUMNS <- c(
  "SAMPLE_ID",
  "Variant_key",
  "GENOMIC_CHANGE",
  "GENOME_VERSION",
  "VARIANT_CLASS",
  "SYMBOL",
  "GENENAME",
  "ALTERATION",
  "PROTEIN_CHANGE",
  "CONSEQUENCE",
  "PFAM_DOMAIN_NAME",
  "LOSS_OF_FUNCTION",
  "LOF_FILTER",
  "VAF_TUMOR",
  "DP_TUMOR",
  "MUTATION_HOTSPOT",
  "MUTATION_HOTSPOT_CANCERTYPE",
  "ONCOGENICITY",
  "ONCOGENICITY_CODE",
  "ONCOGENICITY_SCORE",
  "HGVSc",
  "HGVSp",
  "CGC_TIER",
  "ONCOGENE",
  "ONCOGENE_SUPPORT",
  "TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR",
  "TUMOR_SUPPRESSOR_SUPPORT",
  "CALL_CONFIDENCE"
)

# ============================================================
# 5. Read each PCGR workbook
# ============================================================

results_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(pcgr_files)
)

files_read <- 0L
files_skipped <- 0L

for (i in seq_along(pcgr_files)) {

  file_path <- pcgr_files[i]
  sample_folder <- basename(dirname(file_path))

  cat(
    "[",
    i,
    "/",
    length(pcgr_files),
    "] Reading ",
    sample_folder,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  sheets <- tryCatch(
    excel_sheets(file_path),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Could not inspect workbook: ",
        file_path,
        "\nReason: ",
        e$message
      )
      character()
    }
  )

  if (!"SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL" %in% sheets) {
    warning(
      "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet not found in:\n",
      file_path
    )

    files_skipped <- files_skipped + 1L
    next
  }

  pcgr_dt <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(
      read_excel(
        file_path,
        sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL"
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Could not read SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet:\n",
        file_path,
        "\nReason: ",
        e$message
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(pcgr_dt) || nrow(pcgr_dt) == 0) {
    files_skipped <- files_skipped + 1L
    next
  }

  if (!"SYMBOL" %in% colnames(pcgr_dt)) {
    warning(
      "SYMBOL column was not found in:\n",
      file_path
    )

    files_skipped <- files_skipped + 1L
    next
  }

  # Standardize gene symbols.
  pcgr_dt[, SYMBOL := toupper(trimws(as.character(SYMBOL)))]

  # Retain only the 29 consensus genes.
  selected_dt <- pcgr_dt[
    SYMBOL %in% CONSENSUS_GENES
  ]

  if (nrow(selected_dt) == 0) {
    files_read <- files_read + 1L
    next
  }

  if (all(c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT") %in% names(selected_dt))) {
    selected_dt[, Variant_key := mapply(edit_key, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, USE.NAMES=FALSE)]
  } else if ("GENOMIC_CHANGE" %in% names(selected_dt)) {
    selected_dt[, Variant_key := vapply(GENOMIC_CHANGE, pcgr_key, character(1))]
  } else {
    selected_dt[, Variant_key := NA_character_]
  }

  # Add any missing requested columns as NA.
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    KEEP_COLUMNS,
    colnames(selected_dt)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    for (column_name in missing_columns) {
      selected_dt[, (column_name) := NA_character_]
    }
  }

  # Keep a consistent column order.
  selected_dt <- selected_dt[
    ,
    ..KEEP_COLUMNS
  ]

  # Add source identifiers.
  selected_dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      SAMPLE_FOLDER = sample_folder,
      PCGR_FILE = file_path
    )
  ]

  setcolorder(
    selected_dt,
    c(
      "SAMPLE_FOLDER",
      "SAMPLE_ID",
      "SYMBOL",
      setdiff(
        colnames(selected_dt),
        c(
          "SAMPLE_FOLDER",
          "SAMPLE_ID",
          "SYMBOL",
          "PCGR_FILE"
        )
      ),
      "PCGR_FILE"
    )
  )

  results_list[[i]] <- selected_dt
  files_read <- files_read + 1L
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Combine results
# ============================================================

results_list <- Filter(
  Negate(is.null),
  results_list
)

if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No variants from the 29 genes were found in the PCGR files."
  )
}

combined_dt <- rbindlist(
  results_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Resolve workbook sample identity against MAF samples. Never match by gene alone.
resolve_sample <- function(id, folder) {
  candidates <- unique(clean_sample(c(id, folder)))
  hits <- candidates[!is.na(candidates) & candidates %in% maf_dt$Sample_key]
  if (length(hits) > 1L) stop("Conflicting workbook and folder sample identifiers.")
  if (length(hits) == 1L) hits else NA_character_
}
combined_dt[, Sample_key := mapply(resolve_sample, SAMPLE_ID, SAMPLE_FOLDER,
                                    USE.NAMES=FALSE)]
combined_dt[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, SYMBOL, Variant_key, sep="|")]
combined_dt[, MATCH_STATUS := fifelse(is.na(Sample_key), "sample_not_in_consensus_MAF",
  fifelse(is.na(Variant_key), "unparsed_genomic_change",
  fifelse(Match_key %in% maf_dt$Match_key, "matched", "not_matched_to_Tier1_common")))]
# Excluded rows may reflect a different tier/caller, consequence filtering, or
# unresolved allele representation; do not infer the tier from exclusion alone.
fwrite(combined_dt[MATCH_STATUS != "matched"],
       sub("\\.tsv$", "_excluded_PCGR_rows.tsv", OUTPUT_FILE), sep="\t", na="")
combined_dt <- combined_dt[MATCH_STATUS == "matched"]
maf_dt[, PCGR_MATCH_STATUS := fifelse(Match_key %in% combined_dt$Match_key,
                                     "matched", "annotation_unknown")]
fwrite(maf_dt, sub("\\.tsv$", "_MAF_match_audit.tsv", OUTPUT_FILE), sep="\t", na="")
counts <- maf_dt[, .(
  Mutated_samples_Tier1_common = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
  Samples_with_matched_PCGR = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[PCGR_MATCH_STATUS == "matched"]),
  Samples_with_unmatched_variants = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[PCGR_MATCH_STATUS != "matched"]),
  MAF_variant_rows = .N,
  Unmatched_variant_rows = sum(PCGR_MATCH_STATUS != "matched")
), by=Hugo_Symbol]
counts[, Cohort_samples := cohort_n]
fwrite(counts, sub("\\.tsv$", "_gene_counts.tsv", OUTPUT_FILE), sep="\t")
print(counts[Hugo_Symbol == "CDH1"])
if (!nrow(combined_dt)) stop("No exact variant matches. Review audits and genomic encoding.")
if (any(maf_dt$PCGR_MATCH_STATUS != "matched")) {
  warning("Some Tier 1 MAF variants lack matched PCGR annotations. Keep these unknown; use gene_counts for denominators.")
}

# Convert VAF to numeric when possible.
combined_dt[
  ,
  VAF_TUMOR := suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR)
  )
]

combined_dt[
  ,
  DP_TUMOR := suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(DP_TUMOR)
  )
]

combined_dt[
  ,
  ONCOGENICITY_SCORE := suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(ONCOGENICITY_SCORE)
  )
]

# Sort consistently.
setorder(
  combined_dt,
  SYMBOL,
  SAMPLE_FOLDER,
  GENOMIC_CHANGE
)

# ============================================================
# 7. Save combined output
# ============================================================

fwrite(
  combined_dt,
  file = OUTPUT_FILE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# 8. Print summary
# ============================================================

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("PCGR extraction completed successfully\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("PCGR files found:             ", length(pcgr_files), "\n")
cat("Files successfully examined:  ", files_read, "\n")
cat("Files skipped:                ", files_skipped, "\n")
cat("Extracted variant rows:       ", nrow(combined_dt), "\n")
cat("Samples with retained rows:   ", uniqueN(combined_dt$SAMPLE_FOLDER), "\n")
cat("Consensus genes represented:  ", uniqueN(combined_dt$SYMBOL), " of 29\n")
cat("Output:\n", OUTPUT_FILE, "\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("Variant rows by gene:\n")

print(
  combined_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Variant_rows = .N,
      Mutated_samples = uniqueN(SAMPLE_FOLDER),
      Median_VAF = if (
        all(is.na(VAF_TUMOR))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        median(VAF_TUMOR, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      LOF_annotated_rows = sum(
        !is.na(LOSS_OF_FUNCTION) &
          trimws(as.character(LOSS_OF_FUNCTION)) != ""
      ),
      Oncogenic_rows = sum(
        ONCOGENICITY == "Oncogenic",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Likely_Oncogenic_rows = sum(
        ONCOGENICITY == "Likely_Oncogenic",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),
    by = SYMBOL
  ][order(-Mutated_samples, -Variant_rows)]
)

missing_genes <- setdiff(
  CONSENSUS_GENES,
  unique(combined_dt$SYMBOL)
)

if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  cat("\nConsensus genes with no retained PCGR variant rows:\n")
  cat(
    paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )
}
```
